newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - June 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - June 3.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Moves are afoot to establish a Russia-Sri Lanka Business Council following a visit to Sri Lanka this week by a Russian trade delegation, Trade Ministry officials say.
High-flying Sri Lankan cricket team leave for West Indies on their maiden tour of the Carribean.
Water consumers up in arms over a decision by the National Water Board to increase rates by 100 percent from March.
Troops and Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) rebels exchange artillery and mortar fire in north.
LTTE have sent explosives hidden in a truck carrying sand to Colombo to cause destruction in city, a captured rebel tells military investigators.
Opposition leader and former prime minister Ranil Wickremesinghe to visit Britian this week. He has been invited by the new Labour government.
